user_query: I'm organizing a surprise birthday party for my friend and I need to send an OTP SMS to her. Can you help me send an OTP SMS to the mobile number '9876543210'? It would be great if the message can include the party venue and time. Also, I would like to check the SSL information for the party venue's website. Please provide the SSL details for the domain 'partyvenue.com'.

TaskList.description: Prepare the content for the OTP SMS, including the party venue and time.
Send an OTP SMS to the mobile number '9876543210' with the prepared content.
Retrieve the SSL information for the party venue's website 'partyvenue.com'.
